Field noteKuCoinDual Investment

Field note / 14 Oct 2026

“Buy low. Sell high.”

Sounds like a joke. It is also basically the holy grail of trading.

If you consistently knew when “low” was actually low and “high” was actually high, you probably wouldn’t need another trading strategy.

We previously looked at CoinMarketCap and Binance Skills. This time, we’re looking at KuCoin.

And there is something more interesting here.

KuCoin’s retail products don’t just explain trading ideas. Dual Investment, for example, gives users actual target prices, settlement dates and APRs around a very simple promise: Buy Low or Sell High.

So we’re going to collect those offers and test them.

QuestionsCan a retail trader actually trade this profitably?Does the advertised yield compensate for the risk?Do changes in KuCoin’s prices, strikes and APRs contain any information about what the market does next?

Maybe there is a signal.

Maybe it is just volatility dressed up as a strategy.

Let’s find out.

New Karaptic Lab coming. This is a research preview, not a trading recommendation or financial advice.
